do.en: We do many fun things together at school every day.
do.cn: 我们每天在学校一起做很多有趣的事。

read.en: I read storybooks for half an hour before bed.
read.cn: 睡前我看故事书半小时。

write.en: I write a letter to my grandma every month.
write.cn: 我每月给奶奶写一封信。

study.en: If you study a little every day, you will be great.
study.cn: 如果你每天学一点，你会很棒。

draw.en: He can draw the school in just a few minutes.
draw.cn: 他几分钟就能画出学校。

watch.en: On Friday night we watch a movie at home.
watch.cn: 周五晚我们在家看电影。

TV.en: Don't watch too much TV — it's not good for your eyes.
TV.cn: 不要看太久电视，对眼睛不好。

every day.en: I practise the piano for thirty minutes every day.
